summary: On OpenShift the gateway must be scaled out enough because uWSGI drops requests once more than 100 are backlogged, logging '*** uWSGI listen queue of socket ":8000" (fd: 3) full !!! (101/100) ***' and timing out clients; the backlog is tied to the kernel somaxconn, which can only be raised by allowing unsafe sysctls.
questions: What does 'uWSGI listen queue of socket full' mean?
Why are AAP API requests timing out on OpenShift?
How do I raise the uWSGI backlog in AAP on OpenShift?

answer_card.title: uWSGI listen queue full on OpenShift
answer_card.answer_md:
```
*** uWSGI listen queue of socket ":8000" (fd: 3) full !!! (101/100) ***
```

uWSGI drops requests once more than 100 are queued, so clients time out. The backlog is tied to the kernel parameter `somaxconn`, which on OpenShift can only be raised by allowing unsafe sysctls.

Fix: scale the platform gateway (and API) pods horizontally so requests do not back up.
